structured_stats.description:
The '''Hacker''' is a hardcore tower that hacks enemies, applying various effects to them. It can be purchased from the store for {{Gem|5,500}} or through a gamepass for {{Robux|1,574}}. It damages enemies using synapses fired from its equipment, which starts off with a smartphone, then some sort of wrist gadget and in the bottom path, a laptop. These beams target a single enemy, dealing single target damage. Any enemy attacked by the '''Hacker''' will have these effects applied to it: #First hack is ''Unit Conversion'', unlocked at Level 0. When the enemy is killed, it will be converted into a hologram, with reduced health. This hologram will function similarly to a [[Units|unit]], dealing damage to an enemy upon collision. The converted enemy will ignore defense and [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] of the enemy it is colliding with. If the converted enemy has defense, this defense will boost the damage it deals to other enemies. [[Bloated]] does also boost the health of such enemies. [[Boss]] enemies are unable to be converted into holograms.
Enemy health is calculated using their max health and the tower's EV. Health is calculated as:
\text{Max Health}^\text{EV} #Second hack is ''Wire Fraud''. Enemies targeted by the '''Hacker''' will have their rewards on death or damage increased. This is a global boost, meaning everyone in the match receives the added income. #Third hack is ''Slowness''. This applies a slowness effect to any enemy, as long as it is not a [[Boss]] enemy. The '''Hacker''' also has an ability, ''Hologram Tower'', which allows it to duplicate a tower. It can duplicate any tower on the map and place it down in any spot. This tower will last for a limited amount of time and disappear once the lifetime ends. The cloned tower will have the hologram modifier on it. The ability has a varying cost based on the total cost of the cloned tower. '''Hacker''' cannot clone other '''Hackers''' or itself. If a cloned tower has a placement limit, then there can only be as many clones of that tower from one player at a time as its placement limit. For example, the [[Gatling Gun]] can only have one clone from a player at a time due to the tower having a placement limit of one. The '''Hacker''' has hidden detection from Level 2. It has a placement limit of two per player.

==Description==
The '''Fatigue Debuff''' is a debuff that increases a tower's firerate, making them fire slower. It is displayed on the tower itself with the icon of a ball and chain.

==Mechanics==
Currently, the '''Fatigue Debuff''' is calculated as:

::<big>'''Original Firerate + Original Firerate × (Fatigue Debuff ÷ (1 + Fatigue Debuff))'''</big>
::: where '''Fatigue Debuff''' is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

While it may look like the firerate of a tower with the '''Firerate Debuff''' is rounded up or down to the second decimal, this is only visual. The number can be far longer than what is displayed.

The firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] is calculated as:

::<big>'''(Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) + (Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 + Fatigue Debuff ÷ (1 + Fatigue Debuff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>
:::where ''Bugged Firerate'' is the firerate with the [[Firerate Bug]].

Prior to the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]], '''Fatigue Debuff''' was calculated as:

::<big>'''Original Firerate × (1 + Firerate Debuff)'''</big>

The firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] was calculated as:

::<big>'''((Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 + Fatigue Debuff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>

**Their main firerate can still be increased.

*Charge-up and cooldown of various burst or burst adjacent attacks, such as the [[Soldier]], [[Freezer]] and [[Accelerator]].

==Description==
The '''Scared Debuff''' is a debuff that decreases a tower's range. It is displayed on the tower itself using the icon of a ghost. Multiple ghosts will also appear out of the tower.

==Mechanics==
'''Scared Debuff''' range reduction is calculated as:
::<big>'''Range × (1 - Scared Debuff)'''</big>
:::where '''Scared Debuff''' is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The range of a tower affected by the '''Scared Debuff''' can be in decimal form, instead of being rounded down or rounded up to the nearest integer. For example, a tower with 5 range with a 50% '''Scared Debuff''' will have a range of 2.5.

'''Damage Indicators''' are numbers that pop up on enemies when a tower is selected. These numbers are how much damage was dealt to the enemy. It can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. The '''Freezer''' targets a single enemy and fires a ''Frost Ray'', chilling the enemy and slowing it down. The chillness slowness effect stacks with each hit multiple times. This chillness effect also deals damage over time, chipping away the health of enemies affected by it. Starting from Level 2, it can freeze enemies. When the chillness slowness effect is higher than the max slowdown, the enemy will be frozen, which generally when targeting a single enemy takes four or five shots. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen, slowed down or have their defense dropped by the '''Freezer'''. At Level 3+, the '''Freezer''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between them. Additionally, at Level 3+, it drops defense by 10% every tick. It can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. On top of this, it will also start dealing damage over time with its chill at Level 3. Additionally at Level 4, the '''Freezer''' gains the ability to throw a '''Frost Grenade''', freezing enemies within an explosion radius. The '''Freezer''' does well as an all-rounder support tower. Due to its generally low price and decent DPS, the '''Freezer''' can be a solid choice for early-game defense to mid game with very good cost efficiency. Towards late game, the '''Freezer''' is useful for stalling, defense melting and deal additional DPS through its damage over time, though its DPS is insufficient to deal with late-game waves alone.
